items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: And everybody in our new band, they eat grass and seeds. Well Cat Daddy is a professional runner.

ctx.x: You can say that again. I’m a strong voucher for that.

And you’ve really got to take care of yourself on the road. See, believe me. And everybody in our new band, they eat grass and seeds. Well Cat Daddy is a professional runner. He’s a champion in his age group. And these guys just don’t drink. They don’t drink, they eat salads and stuff like that.
